title: Fundamentals of Law
duration: 45 hours of lectures, 105 hours of self-study

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the origin and nature of the state
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the origin and nature of the state, including the socialist republic of Vietnam.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the organizational principles and operations of the Vietnamese government apparatus
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will comprehend the organizational principles and operations of the Vietnamese government apparatus, including its structure and functions.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Basic knowledge about laws and legal systems
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will gain basic knowledge about laws and legal systems, including legal norms and legal relationships.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Identifying violations of law and their consequences
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to identify violations of law and understand the possible legal consequences for offenders.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying knowledge to determine the authority of government agencies
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will apply their knowledge to determine the authority of government agencies in various activities such as drafting and enforcing laws.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Group work skills to solve simple legal issues
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will develop group work skills to address simple legal issues in administrative, criminal, and civil fields.
Students will learn to comply with rules and regulations of organizations and authorities and recognize their responsibilities.
